description: Scrollytelling container + aggregate morph + small-multiples grid. Introduce a SeasonStory container holding the phase state machine (mandala | smallMultiples | profile) and lifting hoverPlayer/lockedPlayer; add an IntersectionObserver sentinel that flips mandala <-> smallMultiples (triggered, not scrubbed); render the 1043 mandala squares ONCE in a shared SVG coordinate space and morph their transforms (identity START -> fingerprint-wedge-centroid END) via a CSS class toggled by phase, so squares of the same player+slot converge/merge into 11 fingerprints; fade the Mandala center readout out during the morph; reverse on scroll-up; honor prefers-reduced-motion. Render the small-multiples END grid (4 cols of <Fingerprint> + names) with the locked mock title/subtitle/amber prompt. Depends on FEAT-001 (shared geometry + Fingerprint).
steps: Create src/SeasonStory.jsx + src/SeasonStory.css. Move the legend row + <Mandala> wiring out of src/SeasonPoster.jsx into SeasonStory (SeasonPoster then renders <SeasonStory/>), lifting state: phase ('mandala'|'smallMultiples'|'profile'), profilePlayer, plus the existing hoverPlayer/lockedPlayer that Mandala and the legend share. Keep <Mandala> MOUNTED as Scene 1 (do not unmount/remount it between phases). Document in a top comment the single-SVG-coordinate-system decision: morph squares and small-multiples live in one transform space (translate(CX,CY)); transforms are computed once per layout and CSS eases the class toggle — no per-frame React re-render of 1043 nodes.

Add a 1px sentinel <div> below the Scene-1 block and an IntersectionObserver (useEffect + useRef) that sets phase to 'smallMultiples' when the sentinel enters the viewport and back to 'mandala' when it leaves. No raw scroll-position math. Do not add any scroll library.

Create the morph layer (src/MorphLayer.jsx + src/MorphLayer.css, or a well-commented section inside SeasonStory). Render a sibling SVG overlay sharing the mandala viewBox (VB_X/VB_Y/VB_W/VB_H) and a <g transform=`translate(${CX},${CY})`>. Render the 1043 <path> segments ONCE from buildGeometry() (imported from mandalaGeometry.js). useMemo a per-square layout table: START transform = identity (native arc position), END transform = translate+scale+rotate that carries each square toward the centroid of its player+slot fingerprint wedge in the 4-col small-multiples grid (derive slot via slotKey(seg.sceneCode); place each player's fingerprint cell using the same 4-col layout the grid uses). Add a small per-square stagger (transition-delay) and reduce opacity on convergence so merged wedges read cleanly ('the mandala gathers itself into 11 fingerprints').

Drive the morph with CSS: a class on the animating <g>/paths toggled by phase transitions transform (and opacity) over ~700-900ms ease-in-out. Use transform-box:fill-box or an explicit transform-origin at the mandala center so per-path transforms are correct. Add will-change:transform on the animating group. Fade the Mandala center readout out as phase leaves 'mandala' (e.g. a prop/class on Mandala's center, or an overlay that covers it) without breaking Mandala's own center logic.

Add a @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) rule so the morph snaps to the END/START state with no tween. Ensure scrolling back up cleanly reverses (END->START) and the mandala + center readout return to normal.

Render the small-multiples END state: an 11-cell grid, 4 columns (matching mocks/scrolly-grid.png), each cell a <Fingerprint name R labels(first cell only) showName onClick=openProfile/>. Above it render the locked copy from the mock: title 'THE ENSEMBLE, ONE BY ONE' (serif, INK ink), subtitle 'each square from the mandala, regrouped into a fingerprint of how every player took the stage' (muted), and amber (#ff9e45) prompt 'SELECT A PLAYER TO SEE THEIR PROFILE'. The fingerprint positions should line up with where the morphing squares converge so the handoff reads as one continuous object.

Wire fingerprint clicks to set phase='profile' + profilePlayer (the PlayerProfile component itself is FEAT-003; here just set the state and leave a placeholder/no-op render for 'profile' so the build stays green).
acceptance_criteria: In `npm run dev`, scrolling down past the mandala eases (700-900ms) the 1043 squares from their arc positions into 11 fingerprints while the center readout fades out; scrolling back up reverses the animation and restores the mandala + center readout.
The small-multiples grid is a 4-column layout of 11 fingerprints with player names and the mock's title/subtitle/amber prompt, visually matching mocks/scrolly-grid.png.
With OS 'reduce motion' set (or prefers-reduced-motion emulated in devtools), the transition snaps instead of animating.
The existing Mandala behavior (hover, lock, center readout when in 'mandala' phase, group outlines, rim labels) and the Export poster PNG all still work.
verification: Run `npm run build` and confirm exit code 0.
Run `npm run dev` and verify: forward morph on scroll-down, reverse on scroll-up, center-text fade, 4-col grid matches the mock, reduced-motion snaps, and Export poster still downloads a correct PNG.
Confirm there is no per-frame React re-render of all 1043 nodes (transforms memoized once per layout; CSS drives the tween).
